sections.heading: About this policy
sections.body: Pulse by SBH, also called Pulse, is a personal routine tracker by Science By Hugs. This draft describes the current app. Operator identity, privacy contact, distribution territories and retention settings must be confirmed before publication. Version: 2026-10-12. Effective date: to be set on publication.

sections.heading: Information you provide
sections.body: We collect your account email and authentication information. Optional profile information includes your name, contact phone number and selected profile photo. You may enter protocol and substance names, categories, amounts, units, routes, schedules, dates, injection-site records, completion/skip history, inventory quantities, container dates and lot numbers. Optional daily check-ins include sleep, energy, mood and notes. These records may reveal sensitive health information.

sections.heading: Information generated by the service
sections.body: We create account and record identifiers, timestamps, local dates, time-zone information, correction history, schedule versions and sync/cancellation records to operate the service. Our hosting and authentication providers may process connection information such as IP addresses, request metadata and security logs. A time zone is not GPS location. The reviewed app does not request precise location or integrate HealthKit or Health Connect.

sections.heading: How we use information
sections.body: We use information to authenticate accounts, save and synchronize your records, display your history, manage inventory, provide user-configured reminders and calendar entries, generate requested exports, support you, and secure and maintain the service. Check-in summaries describe your entries; they do not establish medical causation. Optional profile photos and check-ins are not required for basic tracking.

sections.heading: Providers and disclosures
sections.body: Supabase provides backend authentication, database and private profile-photo storage. Expo provides app development/build/distribution infrastructure; Apple and Google provide their platforms and related services. Their processing depends on the service you use. We may provide limited access to authorized personnel and contracted providers for service operation, security and requested support, or disclose information when legally required. We do not operate advertising, data-sale or health-data AI-training features in the reviewed app. Confirm actual vendor practices and contracts before publishing this statement.

sections.heading: Your sharing choices
sections.body: Calendar sync is optional. Calendar entries can be accessible to your calendar provider and anyone you allow to access that calendar. Private notification titles are enabled by default; names and quantities can appear if you enable detailed text. Widgets display due counts. PDF reports are generated on your device and are not uploaded to Pulse storage; temporary native report files are removed after sharing finishes. Saved/shared exports and calendar copies are outside Pulse and may be retained by their recipients. Review sharing destinations before sending sensitive records.

sections.heading: Permissions and device storage
sections.body: Photo access selects an optional avatar; the app uploads a resized JPEG rather than your entire photo library. Notification, calendar and biometric-lock features use optional platform permissions. Pulse receives a biometric authentication result, not your face or fingerprint template. Native sessions, cached routine records and pending logs use platform secure storage. The web app uses browser storage for sessions and local state. See our Device Storage Notice for more detail. Optional substance photos are resized and stored on this device only, separately from the backend profile photo. On native devices they use private secure storage; on web they use browser storage. They can be replaced or removed and included in an account export from this device.

sections.heading: Retention and deletion
sections.body: Synced account records are retained while your account exists unless you remove supported records. Corrections and schedule versions preserve history rather than overwriting it. In-app account deletion removes the authentication account, associated application records and stored profile photo from active systems. Backups and provider security logs may remain for their configured retention periods; these durations and any legally required exceptions must be verified before publication. Deletion does not remove exports, screenshots or third-party calendar copies. See Account Deletion for requests made without app access.

sections.heading: Your controls and rights
sections.body: You can update profile details, remove your photo, edit supported records, export your account data and request account deletion in Account & Privacy. You can disable reminders/calendar sync or revoke OS permissions. Depending on your location, you may have access, correction, deletion, consent-withdrawal, appeal or other privacy rights. We verify requests using proportionate account-verification steps and will not ask you to email a password. Required request/appeal contact details must be supplied before publication.

sections.heading: Security and international processing
sections.body: Account ownership restrictions and other safeguards limit access to records. No service is perfectly secure. Protect your device, account and exports. Providers may process data outside your country; hosting regions, applicable transfer safeguards and contractual arrangements must be confirmed before publication. Pulse does not claim that all data is end-to-end encrypted or that HIPAA applies to every account.

sections.heading: Children and changes
sections.body: The intended minimum age and launch territories remain pending operator confirmation. Do not publish or describe an enforced age restriction until the matching signup controls are implemented. We will update the policy when practices change, identify the effective version, and provide additional notice or obtain consent when required. Business transitions require continued protection of information and any legally required notice/consent.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: This separate draft covers health-related data processed by Pulse by SBH. It supplements the Privacy Policy. Applicable state requirements and final wording must be reviewed for the confirmed operator and launch locations. Version: 2026-10-12; effective date pending publication.

sections.heading: Categories and sources
sections.body: Health data may include your entered substances/medications, quantities, routes, sites, schedules, completion/skips, inventory, sleep, energy, mood and notes, and associated dates, time zones and correction/schedule history. We receive this information from you and generate tracking records from your interactions. The current app does not obtain medical records from a clinician or import health-platform data.

sections.heading: Purposes of collection
sections.body: We process these records to provide the tracking, sync, reminders, history, inventory, check-in summaries and exports you request. We do not use these features to diagnose conditions, prescribe or choose treatments. We do not operate health-data advertising, sale or AI-training features in the reviewed app.

sections.heading: Sharing and recipients
sections.body: Supabase processes synced records for hosting and authentication. Authorized service personnel/providers may access limited information where needed to operate or secure the service or respond to support. You can choose to disclose information through calendar sync, detailed notifications or exports to recipients you select. Legal disclosures may occur where required. Confirm the final processor/recipient list and contracts before publishing.

sections.heading: Consent and withdrawal
sections.body: Where applicable law requires consent, collection or sharing beyond what is necessary to provide your requested service must wait for the appropriate consent. Acceptance of terms is not blanket consent to all health-data uses. Disable optional features to stop future optional processing; use deletion controls or the verified privacy contact to request removal or withdraw consent. Some core tracking functionality cannot operate without the records you ask it to process. This draft does not itself implement a consent mechanism.

sections.heading: Access, deletion and appeals
sections.body: Use Account & Privacy to export records or delete the account. For additional health-data access, deletion, withdrawal or appeal requests, contact the privacy address to be confirmed. Requests will be verified proportionately and processed within applicable legal deadlines. Deletion requests must be propagated to applicable processors/recipients where required; exported copies you independently share may be outside our control. Final request and appeal procedures must be established before publication.

sections.heading: Policy link and contact
sections.body: Publish this document through a distinct, conspicuous Consumer Health Privacy link on the public homepage and inside Legal & Privacy. DRAFT: insert confirmed operator and privacy contact details.

sections.heading: Agreement and operator
sections.body: These draft terms govern Pulse by SBH, a personal routine tracker by Science By Hugs. The contracting legal operator and effective date must be confirmed before publication. Version: 2026-10-12. Provide meaningful access to these terms before signup and implement versioned acceptance before relying on them as an agreement.

sections.heading: What Pulse provides
sections.body: Pulse records the routines and quantities you enter, schedules reminders, tracks inventory and displays descriptive history/check-in summaries. It does not provide clinical services or recommend substances, doses, administration methods or treatment changes. Tracking a substance does not establish that it is lawful, approved, safe or effective. Do not use Pulse to make urgent medical decisions.

sections.heading: Eligibility and account responsibilities
sections.body: You must be legally able to enter an agreement and comply with the final minimum-age policy, which is pending confirmation. Provide accurate account information, protect access credentials and report suspected unauthorized access. You are responsible for checking the accuracy of your entries and following qualified medical advice. Never share account passwords with support.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: Use Pulse lawfully. Do not use it to promote illegal activity, upload content you have no right to use, access another person’s records without authorization, compromise security, abuse infrastructure or misrepresent records. Pulse is not a marketplace for substances and provides no authorization to buy, sell or use any substance.

sections.heading: Your records and permission to operate
sections.body: You retain rights in your records and photos. You give the operator the limited permission needed to store, process, display, synchronize and export content to provide the features you request and meet lawful obligations. This is not permission to sell health records or train AI on them. The Privacy and Consumer Health Data Privacy policies explain processing and rights.

sections.heading: Reliability and sharing
sections.body: Reminders can be delayed or blocked by device settings, permissions, connection or platform behavior. Inventory projections depend on entered quantities, schedules and container dates; they are estimates rather than safety/stability guarantees. Confirm important records independently. You control export destinations and calendar sharing; recipient copies may remain after deleting your account.

sections.heading: Beta availability and payments
sections.body: Beta features can change and may contain errors. The reviewed beta has no implemented subscription/payment feature. If paid services are introduced, pricing, renewal, cancellation and refund terms will be disclosed before purchase and applicable platform rules will apply.

sections.heading: App license and platform terms
sections.body: Subject to applicable terms, you may use the app for personal tracking. App intellectual property remains with its owners; third-party components retain their licenses. Apple/Google platform terms continue to apply. These service terms do not replace the applicable App Store EULA. Confirm whether Apple’s standard EULA or a compliant custom license is used before submission.

sections.heading: Suspension, termination and changes
sections.body: You may stop using the service and delete your account. The operator may restrict use where reasonably necessary for security, legal compliance or serious misuse, subject to applicable law. Material changes will be notified appropriately and require renewed acceptance where applicable. A privacy-policy update does not retroactively authorize new health-data uses.

sections.heading: Consumer rights and liability
sections.body: Mandatory consumer and privacy rights remain unaffected. To the extent permitted by law, availability and accuracy are not guaranteed, and liability for interruptions or inaccurate user-entered records may be limited. These draft terms do not exclude liability that cannot lawfully be excluded. Governing law, dispute procedures and any liability limits require review for the confirmed operator and markets; no mandatory arbitration or class-action waiver is imposed by this draft.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: DRAFT: insert confirmed contracting entity and support contact. Counsel should finalize eligibility, enforceable liability provisions, governing law and dispute handling before publication.

sections.heading: Tracking boundaries
sections.body: Pulse by SBH is a personal record of the routine you enter. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent disease. This description must be reviewed against actual features and marketing; a disclaimer does not determine regulatory classification.

sections.heading: Clinical decisions
sections.body: Pulse does not prescribe, recommend doses, choose an injection site or establish whether a peptide, medication or supplement is safe or effective. Consult a qualified clinician or pharmacist before starting, stopping or changing a substance or routine. Follow their instructions and the product’s lawful labeling. A substance name in your records does not imply approval or endorsement.

sections.heading: Reminders and inventory
sections.body: Do not rely on Pulse as your only reminder or clinical record. Reminders and sync can be interrupted. Supply estimates and user-entered expiry/use-by dates do not assess product potency, sterility, storage suitability or stability. Logging or skipping an entry does not determine what you should do next.

sections.heading: Emergency use
sections.body: Pulse is not monitored for emergencies. If you suspect an emergency, contact your local emergency service or seek immediate professional care. Check-in notes are not a clinician messaging service.

sections.heading: Reports
sections.body: Reports reproduce selected user-entered information. They may omit unavailable historical details and are not verified clinical assessments. Review them before sharing.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: This draft describes storage in the reviewed Pulse app and its standalone policy pages. A separate marketing website or future SDKs must be audited independently. Version: 2026-10-12; effective date pending publication.

sections.heading: Native app
sections.body: Pulse uses platform secure storage for authentication sessions, cached records and pending tracking events. Local app preferences support notification privacy, biometric lock and related settings. Device/OS settings may also affect backups and storage. Temporary generated PDF files are removed after sharing completes; copies you save remain in your selected destination. Optional substance photos are stored per account/substance on this device, not uploaded to Pulse or an image-generation provider.

sections.heading: Web app
sections.body: The web app uses browser storage for sign-in sessions and app state. This is not the native secure-store implementation. Signing out ends local authenticated use; account deletion removes associated synced data. Clearing browser storage can remove cached and unsynced information and sign you out.

sections.heading: Policy pages and optional tracking
sections.body: The generated standalone policy pages do not set cookies, load analytics, embed third-party fonts, or use advertising trackers. A hosting provider can still process connection logs. No advertising/analytics SDK is configured in the reviewed app. Any future non-essential tracking requires a new audit, accurate disclosures and consent before activation where required. A cookie banner should match actual technology and applicable law, not be added solely as decoration.

sections.heading: Controls
sections.body: You can manage permissions in device settings, clear browser storage and use the app’s privacy controls. Revoking calendar permission does not necessarily delete existing events. Remove Pulse-created calendar entries before disconnecting or deleting the account if you want those copies removed. DRAFT: add verified privacy contact and hosting details before publication.

sections.heading: Delete inside Pulse
sections.body: Open Pulse, sign in and go to You → Account & Privacy. Choose Delete account & data and confirm. The server removes your profile photo and authentication account; associated synced protocol, item, inventory, tracking, correction, schedule-history and check-in records are removed through account deletion. The deletion must be confirmed by the server; an error is not a completed deletion.

sections.heading: Request deletion without the app
sections.body: DRAFT: supply a monitored support/privacy email or secure request form before publishing this page. Contact that channel with the account email and a request to delete your Pulse account and associated data. We will verify account ownership through a secure process. Do not send your password, medical records or identity documents unless a proportionate verified process specifically requires them. Requests must not require reinstalling the app.

sections.heading: What can remain
sections.body: Copies you exported, screenshots, recipient copies and third-party calendar entries remain outside Pulse. Remove Pulse calendar events before deletion if desired. Provider backups/security logs may persist for their configured retention periods, and narrowly required legal records may be retained. Confirm and publish actual durations/categories before launch; do not promise immediate erasure from all backups.

sections.heading: Export before deleting
sections.body: You can choose Export data in Account & Privacy before deletion. Store the export securely. Deletion is permanent for active account records and cannot be undone through the app.
